name: Jax Handyman Pro

has_own_site_check.finding: jaxhandymanpro.com root (/ and www) 301-redirects to an unrelated business, peoriaheightsplumbing.com (Peoria, IL). The domain also serves cached-looking WordPress subpages (e.g. /about/, /contact-us/) under the name 'Jax Handyman Pro' with phone (904) 204-3739, which is confirmed via web search to belong to a DIFFERENT, now-closed Jacksonville business, '904 Handyman and Home Services' (6999-2 Merrill Rd). Phone does not match the verified business (904-404-6919), so jaxhandymanpro.com is treated as an unrelated/repurposed domain, not this business's real website. Google Maps listing has no website button (confirmed live). Nextdoor business page explicitly lists 'Website: Not provided'. cityof.com directory listing (phone-matched, confirmed same business) has no website field. Conclusion: no real owned website found.

language_evidence: Jacksonville, FL market is majority English; all reviews, the Nextdoor business description, and every source found are in English. No Spanish-language signal found.

sources_checked: cityof.com directory listing (no email, only generic share-via-email widget)
Yelp listing (blocked by anti-bot, 403 on all UAs)
BBB (searched 'Jax Handyman Solutions', confirmed different business: different address 5216 Shirley Ave and different phone 904-840-8848)
jaxhandymanpro.com (confirmed unrelated business via phone mismatch, its info@jaxhandymanpro.com is NOT used)
Instagram @jaxhandymanpro (web_profile_info blocked 401, page fetch blocked 429/302; could not verify phone match so not used as a channel)

instagram_note: Instagram handle @jaxhandymanpro exists with name+city matching 'Jax handyman pro (@jaxhandymanpro) - Jacksonville, FL' in search snippets, but the profile could not be fetched (IG blocked all attempts: web_profile_info 401, page fetch 429/302, ig_photos.py service returned only 1 non-post asset which was a generic IG UI icon, not a real photo). Phone number on the IG profile could not be verified. Per pipeline rule requiring a solid name+city+phone match, IG was NOT used as a listed contact channel; phone is used as the sole verified channel instead.
photos_source: Public Nextdoor business page (nextdoor.com/pages/jax-handyman-pro-jacksonville-fl/) exposed 1 cover photo + 12 post photos as plain src URLs (us1-photo.nextdoor.com) without requiring login. Verified as the correct business via exact name, phone (904-404-6919) and address (1903 Ashmore Green Dr) match on the same page. Plus 1 photo from the Google Maps listing (lh3.googleusercontent.com) provided directly. Curated down from 14 downloaded images to 10 used (dropped near-duplicate angles of the same kitchen and one unappealing mid-process shot).

sample_review_found.author: J. G.
sample_review_found.text: I recently moved here and was in need of a handyman. I came across Jax Handyman pro. They have been great. They were professional and meticulous with the different jobs I needed done. I have reached out to them twice for additional work. They are my go to for repairs and maintenance issues. I highly recommend them.

services_source: Nextdoor business categories (Flooring service, Drywall repair, Kitchen remodeler, Handyman, House painter, Bathroom remodeling service) plus a business self-description on Nextdoor ('family owned Jacksonville FL Handyman Company that provides Specialty Painting, handyman, remodel, and repair Services for your home and business') and mentions of bathtub resurfacing and kitchen cabinet water damage repair.
